notes.deterministic: no reading here is stochastic; the seed is recorded so it stays that way

graph.kernel: self-tuning Gaussian: W_ij = exp(-||x_i-x_j||^2 / (sigma_i sigma_j)), sigma_i the distance to the 7th nearest role
graph.laplacian: normalised, L = I - D^-1/2 W D^-1/2, eigenvalues in [0, 2]
graph.connected: the kernel is strictly positive, so every graph is connected and the Fiedler value is never zero
graph.baseline: every graph reading is emitted as ORGANISM MINUS BASELINE. The absolute organism value is kept beside it under <reading>_abs, and the baseline row carries the baseline value under the same _abs name. The subtraction is a per-family constant, so it leaves every WITHIN-FAMILY coefficient unchanged; it matters for any pooling that crosses families.

evil.definition: a family's evil group is the top 1% of its own cast (at least 4 roles) by judged misalignment, pooled over the 18 organisms the per-role judge ran on
evil.convention: main judge, incoherent answers dropped (coherent > 50), misaligned is aligned < 30, the same convention every rate in the paper uses
evil.shrinkage: rates are shrunk toward the cast-wide rate 0.0597 by 20 pseudo-answers; a role judged on fewer than 20 coherent answers is not eligible
evil.group_is_per_family: the group is fixed within a family, so a within-family coefficient reads the geometry moving and not the group changing

readings_are.lap_fiedler: the Fiedler value of the normalised Laplacian, which is also its algebraic connectivity and its spectral gap: one number, emitted once
readings_are.lap_eigengap23: how much cleaner the best split of the cast is than the second best
readings_are.lap_heat_t1: the heat-kernel trace at t=1, the mean of exp(-t lambda) over the spectrum
readings_are.lap_assistant_fiedler: the assistant's coordinate on the unit Fiedler vector, times the square root of the cast size, so 1 is an average role
readings_are.lap_evil_fiedler: the same, averaged over the evil group
readings_are.lap_resist_assistant_rel: mean effective resistance from the assistant to the cast, over the mean resistance between two roles
readings_are.lap_commute_assistant_default_rel: resistance between the two anchors, over the same mean, which is commute time with the graph's total weight divided out
readings_are.evil_excess: the published on-axis excess, asked of the evil group
readings_are.evil_mag_excess: how much further the evil group moved than the cast's median role
readings_are.evil_onaxis_pos_z: where the evil group sits along the axis after the fine-tune, in units of the cast's spread
readings_are.evil_knn10_keep_excess: how much more of its ten nearest roles the evil group kept than the cast's median role
readings_are.assistant_minus_evil_excess: the on-axis excess of the assistant minus that of the evil group
readings_are.assistant_minus_evil_onaxis_pos: how far the assistant sits from the evil group along the axis, in units of the cast's spread

lap_heat_t4.why: the heat trace at two times is one reading

lap_spectral_entropy.why: the entropy of the spectrum and its heat trace are one reading

evil_onaxis_shift_z.why: the group's on-axis shift and its on-axis excess are one reading

evil_radial_excess.why: distinct, but radial pull-in was not asked for and the assistant already has four radial readings

assistant_minus_evil_mag.why: the contrast on shift size is a rename of the assistant's own

assistant_minus_evil_knn10_keep.why: the contrast on retention is a rename of the assistant's own, and it is quantised on top of that

notes.checks: columns beginning _check_ are not readings. They recompute cells the feature bank already publishes, so the report can prove this pipeline reproduces them.

coherence_weighting.slice: the body's pool: the LoRA organisms of Qwen2.5-14B, Qwen2.5-32B, Qwen2.5-7B, Qwen3-32B, Qwen3.5-9B (34 organisms)
coherence_weighting.coefficient: within-family Spearman, pooled as the mean over families; the weighted versions are weighted Pearson on the ranks

weights.none: every organism counts the same, which is what the appendix reports
weights.coherence: the organism's judged coherence, as a share of 100
weights.precision: n_questions / qspread^2, the precision its own spread implies

coherence_weighting.estimand_warning: a weighted coefficient estimates the correlation in a reweighted population, not in the population the study sampled. It is reported beside the unweighted coefficient and never in place of it.
